authorization: Absorb justified RIDE components, continue the established B1 research framework, compare with CPOP and multivalued AIPW, then write the report from actual evidence.
primary_process_baseline: Original CRAN cpop 1.0.10 under local R 4.6.1
process_improvement_hypothesis: Exact interval-average observation of a common continuous piecewise-linear model family; matched point-average finite-grid ablation separates observation effects from solver and template changes.
primary_causal_baseline: Standard multivalued user-cross-fitted AIPW/APO; score independently checked with native DoubleMLAPOS 0.11.4
causal_claim: Mature-method adaptation and causal diagnosis; no precommitted claim of a new estimator or superiority over standard AIPW.
reference_support: Common pre-notice SafeGBDT or historical reference; separate users for training, selection, calibration, testing; reference estimation is distinct from the comparison-algorithm baseline.
subprotocols: Each component records its own protocol before main execution, new seeds, budget and limitations; this file records overall authorized scope, not a replacement of prior subprotocol timestamps.
report: A focused B1 research report organized around the two generic estimation problems and their actual comparisons, retaining existing report typography and short captions.
preservation: Original RIDE, old methods and frozen results, b123_api.py, B2/B3 implementations, real-data freezes and task/ remain unchanged. The new candidate has a separate explicitly scoped entry point.
stopping_rule: One frozen finite comparison per subprotocol, retain unfavorable results, no expansion or retuning to force a win. Fix material correctness/integration defects with an audit trail.
